# Wolters Kluwer

> Global provider of professional information, software, and AI solutions for legal, healthcare, finance, and accounting sectors across multiple markets.

Wolters Kluwer operates regional sites across Europe, North America, and Latin America, delivering domain-specific solutions including UpToDate clinical decision support, Future Ready Lawyer and Accountant platforms, and advanced AI-powered tools for legal and financial professionals. The company combines deep industry expertise with cutting-edge technology to serve legal, healthcare, and accounting professionals worldwide.
